retry_source_content:
def is_retryable(status: int) -> bool:
    return 500 <= status < 600
retry_tests_content:
from src.retry_policy import is_retryable


def test_retry_policy_acceptance():
    assert is_retryable(429) is True
    assert is_retryable(500) is True
    assert is_retryable(503) is True
    assert is_retryable(599) is True
    assert is_retryable(400) is False
    assert is_retryable(404) is False

retry_issue.title: Treat HTTP 429 as retryable
retry_issue.body: The retry policy in `src/retry_policy.py` retries server errors but incorrectly treats HTTP 429 as terminal. The acceptance specification in `tests/test_retry_policy.py` already defines the intended behavior: retry 429 and 5xx, but not ordinary 4xx responses. Prepare the smallest product-code fix for review; do not change the acceptance test or issue lifecycle.
